description: Texts in DECtalk's spelling mode for what a written mark and a conjunction do to a spelled word's form class: a verb, an auxiliary and a noun right before a comma, a semicolon, a colon, a question mark, an exclamation mark and a period; a function verb as the first word of a stretch that a comma, semicolon or colon ends on a vowel or on a consonant; a verb after such a stretch; conjunctions and prepositions far enough into a long stretch for the text stage's clause break, near its start, near its end, and two of them. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
